text:
ana: quick dry run of helios13b conversion on staging. ran convert_weights.py and safetensors packaging, script finished but smoke tests failed — tokenizer + shard-layout warnings.
kevin: can you drop the s3 path for the raw weights so i can inspect locally?
ana: s3://redwood-models/onboarding/helios13b/v1/ (manifest uploaded).
sophie: curious what the logs show, any warnings?
ana: logs pasted below:
```
2026-03-15 14:02:01 INFO mapping shards -> found 12 shards
2026-03-15 14:02:02 WARNING shard-layout mismatch: expected tp_shards=8 but got 12 -> falling back to split semantics
2026-03-15 14:02:03 ERROR tokenizer.json missing special_tokens_map entry for "<|pad|>"; vocab offset mismatch detected
2026-03-15 14:02:04 WARN tensor dtype check: mixed dtype detected (fp16/bf16) in layer_45.attn.kv.weight
```
ryan: looks like the original checkpoint was saved with a data-parallel split that yields 12 files; our conversion assumed tp=8. try running with --tp-layout=interleaved or set --shards=8 mapping flag. also the dtype warning is concerning.
kevin: also ensure safetensors header isn't lying — sometimes metadata preserved from old dump says bf16 even though payload is fp16. run `safetensors inspect <file>` to confirm.
ana: good call. script command i ran: `python tools/convert_weights.py --src s3://redwood-models/onboarding/helios13b/v1/ --out /tmp/helios13b/safetensors --dtype fp16 --tp 8`
sophie: if the source was 12 shards we probably need to recombine or use converter flag `--expect-shards 12 --target-tp 8` so it reshards correctly.
ana: i retried with `--tp-layout interleaved --expect-shards 12 --dtype fp16` and the converter completed but tokenizer still flagged.
kevin: what's the tokenizer diff? maybe special token indices shifted during merges.
nana: diff snippet: `tokenizer.json` missing "pad_token": "<|pad|>" and special_tokens_map absent. running small sample prompts yields off-by-one in tokenization (eos appended at different index).
ryan: likely upstream tokenizer generation step dropped special_tokens_map when merging merges.txt -> vocab.json. quick fix: regenerate tokenizer from original tokenizer files + add special_tokens_map explicitly, then re-run convert with `--tokenizer-path /path/to/tokenizer.json`.
sophie: i'll take tokenizer regen. will keep merges order exactly.
build-bot: artifact uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/helios13b/dryrun/1976012345/ (sha256: abc123def456)
kevin: i'll run a local smoke serve against that artifact with `--quantize none` to isolate tokenization vs runtime issues.
ana: serving fails with `n_ctx mismatch` error — config.json n_ctx was 4096 but model expects 8192, tokenizer vocab indexing produced index 50256 for eos.
ryan: update config.json n_ctx to 8192 and ensure tokenizer vocab size matches model config.n_vocab.
sophie: PR created with regenerated tokenizer + config bump: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482
kevin: kicking off CI on that PR now. if green i'll re-run packaging with `--dtype fp16 --tp-layout interleaved --shards 8`.
sophie: note to self: add a packaging validation step that compares `vocab_size` in config.json vs len(tokenizer.vocab) and checks for `special_tokens_map` keys before artifact publish.
ana: thanks — will update onboarding checklist. also we should add a small KV-cache key-order test as part of smoke tests; silent mismatch can cause weird attention artifacts.
ryan: filing follow-up ticket INF-2319 for KV-cache ordering test and automated dtype header checks: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2319
ana: once packaging passes i'll push to staging and cross-post to eng-platform for rollout gating. closing updates here unless someone needs more details. :thumbsup:
